data.body: **P2:** The sampling intent remains embedded in this immutable parent `Context`; `consume()` clears only the system-property bridge. OpenTelemetry passes that same context to `SpanProcessor.onStart`, so a processor that creates an unrelated span using the supplied parent (or `parent.with(span)`) inherits the execution's forced sampling decision instead of its configured sampler. Make the same-classloader context carrier consume-once as well, and add an `onStart` regression that starts the callback span with the provided parent context.
